_description: Structured feature tags for rule-based case matching in Agent 3 analysis.
_matching_logic: Agent 3 builds a case_profile from the current case, then matches against these tags. Exact match on violation_type + subject_level = high relevance. Partial match on 2+ dimensions = medium.

cases.name: Official Vehicle Misuse / Private Vehicle Using Public Funds
cases.violation_type: Integrity Discipline - Violation of Eight-point Regulation + Embezzlement (Wind-to-Corruption)
cases.mental_state: Knowing and willful - Intent to unlawfully possess
cases.penalty: Serious Party Internal Warning + Administrative Demotion
cases.key_ruling: Official vehicle for personal use = conduct issue (minor); Private vehicle using public funds = corruption issue (severe) - Distinguishing 'conduct' from 'corruption'

cases.name: Fault Tolerance and Error Correction - Dual-Factor Analysis
cases.violation_type: Fault Tolerance and Error Correction Mechanism
cases.mental_state: Intent to promote development - No personal gain
cases.key_ruling: Violation does not equal disciplinary violation - Requires three-dimensional judgment of 'violation elements + culpability elements + exculpatory circumstances'

cases.name: Obstructing Organizational Investigation
cases.violation_type: Political Discipline - Obstructing Organizational Investigation + Bribe-Taking
cases.mental_state: Deliberate deception - Intent to obstruct investigation
cases.penalty: Expulsion from the Party + Dismissal from Public Office + Referral to Judicial Authorities
cases.key_ruling: Failure to truthfully respond during inquiry + collusion to fabricate evidence = collectively determined as obstructing organizational investigation (Political Discipline), not Organizational Discipline

cases.name: Formalism and Bureaucratism
cases.violation_type: Violation of Eight-point Regulation - Formalism and Bureaucratism
cases.key_ruling: Formalism and Bureaucratism = violation of Eight-point Regulation, stated separately in adjudication documents. If consequences resulted, handle per regulations; if no consequences, apply First Form

cases.name: Blank Official Letter Embezzlement
cases.violation_type: Integrity Discipline - Embezzlement (Blank Official Letter Reimbursement)
cases.penalty: Serious Party Internal Warning + Administrative Major Demerit
cases.key_ruling: Blank official letter reimbursement = embezzlement (not ordinary irregular dining). Distinguish personal embezzlement from collective violation

cases.name: Irregular Dining with Mixed Public-Private Funds
cases.violation_type: Integrity Discipline - Irregular Public-Funded Dining (Mixed Public-Private)
cases.key_ruling: Mixed public-private banquets - split treatment: public-funded portion characterized as disciplinary violation + restitution; personal portion borne by participants themselves

cases.name: Illegal Levy of Fees
cases.violation_type: Mass Line Discipline - Illegal Levy of Fees
cases.penalty: Serious Party Internal Warning + Administrative Demotion
cases.key_ruling: Illegal levy of fees = infringement of public interests (Mass Line Discipline), not ordinary financial violation

cases.name: Irregular Handling of Wedding or Funeral Events
cases.violation_type: Integrity Discipline - Irregular Handling of Wedding or Funeral Events
cases.mental_state: Knowing and willful - Intent to collect money through events
cases.penalty: Party Internal Warning to Serious Warning
cases.key_ruling: No blanket prohibition - Key considerations: 'whether authority or position influence was leveraged' + 'whether adverse social impact was caused' + local economic and customary factors

cases.name: Irregular Acceptance of Banquets After Retirement
cases.violation_type: Integrity Discipline - Irregular Acceptance of Banquets After Retirement
cases.key_ruling: Retirement does not equal immunity - Accepting banquets after retirement by leveraging former authority or position-established convenience conditions can still constitute a disciplinary violation

cases.name: Simplistic and Overbroad Accountability
cases.key_ruling: Accountability cannot be 'one-size-fits-all' - Must distinguish direct responsibility / leadership responsibility; cannot pursue accountability for its own sake

cases.name: Fraudulently Obtaining Agricultural Subsidies
cases.violation_type: Mass Line Discipline - Fraudulent Subsidy Obtainment + Embezzlement
cases.penalty: Revocation of Party Position + Confiscation of Illegal Gains
cases.key_ruling: Grassroots cadre fraudulently obtaining agricultural subsidies = Mass Line Discipline + Embezzlement dual characterization. Village committee director recommended to resign from position
